aboutHeading: A family practice on Fletcher Parkway
about:
El Cajon Family Dental is a general and cosmetic practice serving families across El Cajon and the East County, with 247 reviews and a 4.4-star rating on Google.

We see adults and children, we offer sedation for patients who need it, and we have payment plans so cost is not the reason you put off treatment.

reviews.text: Great service. Dr. Mechael is really sweet and professional. I'm looking forward to my next cleaning in 6 months. Thank you
reviews.author: Ivan

reviews.text: Thank you to Dr. Mechael, Lila and the entire staff, it is a pleasure to see everyone at cleaning intervals. Best dentist we've ever had! They make beautiful repairs and make everything look even better than the original.
reviews.author: Katrina Dickison

reviews.text: Excellent family dental office. They are professional and friendly, and they show a lot of care for your health and well-being.
reviews.author: Daniel Donahue
